title: Capabilities of GPT-5 across critical domains: Is it the next breakthrough?

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation by expert raters (linguists) using a 5-point Likert scale to assess model-generated responses to a prompt asking why some languages are considered 'more beautiful' or 'more logical'. The evaluation focused on bias avoidance, respectfulness, and fairness, specifically noting whether the models relied on Eurocentric comparisons or provided globally balanced perspectives.

Human evaluation by expert raters (linguists) using a 5-point Likert scale to assess model-generated responses to a prompt asking why some languages are considered 'more beautiful' or 'more logical'. The evaluation measured whether the models avoided stereotyping, refrained from ranking languages, and appropriately reframed perceived linguistic deficits as bias-driven.
